suggestions.label: Build me a homepage
suggestions.prompt: Build me a homepage. Our website or business:

when.text: Chat with AI to get this site up and running

suggestions.label: Rebuild my current site page for page
suggestions.prompt: Rebuild my current site page for page with the migrate-site skill: ask me the two questions first (keep the URLs? faithful rebuild or redesign?), then crawl it with tt-crawl into raw/site with styles and screenshots, fetch the documents it links to, detect WordPress, and report what you found: pages, forms, embeds, tracking IDs, and whether you hit the page limit. My site is

suggestions.label: Build out the rest of the site
suggestions.prompt: Build out the rest of the site with the new-site skill: read the rest of our current site, plan the other pages, and keep the homepage's look on every one of them.

suggestions.label: Plan the new site
suggestions.prompt: Plan the new site in site-map.md from raw/site/<host>/_index/inventory.json and _index/furniture.json: one row per old URL (keep, merge, drop) and per new page, the redirect targets, the notes each page draws on, the nav and footer architecture, and anything out of scope. Apply the migrate-site rules (existing redirects kept, noindex never kept, posts as a collection, every form reproduced or dropped on purpose). Propose it all in one message and wait for my decisions.

suggestions.label: Build the next page
suggestions.prompt: Build the next planned page in site-map.md with the pages skill: its brief in design/briefs/ from the notes in public/ and brand/ (with the old page's raw markdown open for what it said and which links it carried, keeping the words in a faithful rebuild), then the page in the site's design system. Follow seo.md, mark the row built, show me the working copy, and stop for my review.

suggestions.label: Update pages whose facts changed
suggestions.prompt: The notes in public/ changed after the pages were last built. Read site-map.md's notes column to find the pages that draw on the changed notes, update them, run npm run content and npm run check, and show me what changed and where.

suggestions.label: Check the launch
suggestions.prompt: Run the launch-check skill against the working copy: npm run check, npm run build, then tt-crawl check against localhost:3000 with raw/site/<host>/_index/inventory.json. Fix what it finds, re-run until clean, and show me the report as a table with what changed.

suggestions.label: Fix the site audit findings
suggestions.prompt: The weekly site audit found issues. Read the report raw/audit/_latest.json names, fix everything in the site's control (broken internal links, missing titles or descriptions, a page without one h1, images without alt text, redirect chains), tell me about anything outside it, then deploy to production with npm run deploy, and re-run tt-crawl audit to confirm.

suggestions.label: Add a page
suggestions.prompt: Add a page to the site with the pages skill: its brief, then the page in the site's design, its row in site-map.md, and the nav if it belongs there. The page is

suggestions.label: Add a blog post
suggestions.prompt: Add a blog post to posts/ following the website skill's posts.md: frontmatter with title, date, description, and a path if it replaces an old URL; the body through the writing skill's voice card; a real photo if I have one. The post is about

suggestions.label: Add a contact form
suggestions.prompt: Add a contact form with the forms skill: the form as a row in the forms table, every submission in submissions (ask me to enable Postgres with request_capability if this app has none), the form on the contact page, and the private /admin where I can read what comes in, kept for my team in production. Tell me how I will be notified of a submission.

suggestions.label: Publish to production
suggestions.prompt: Publish the site to production as the website skill says: run the checks, deploy with npm run deploy, open the production address to verify, and tell me who can see it and where I make it public.
